details:
The VRChat client has long needed a proper power-user update. While creator tools continue to improve, users still lack robust ways to monitor and optimize their client’s performance.

My proposals are as follows:

-------------------------

Performance & Metrics

-------------------------

Frame-time profiler to see real time per-avatar and per-world impact

Performance heat-maps and load visualizations to identify heavy avatars or world areas

-------------------------

Graphics & Rendering Controls

-------------------------

Dynamic texture downscaling & FSR

More granular post-processing controls (shadows, reflections, bloom, etc)

LOD sliders for avatars and world objects to reduce heavy rendering on the fly

-------------------------

Avatar Management & Filtering

-------------------------

Filter avatar & object visibility by tags, description, name, explicit avatar / shader stats

Auto-hide or simplify avatars above certain shader, vertex, or general performance thresholds

Toggle dynamic bones, particles, and other expensive systems PER-AVATAR

-------------------------

Beta / Developer Mode

-------------------------

Many of these features could be overwhelming or unstable for average users

A “Beta” or “Developer” mode in settings (or as a Steam beta) would allow power users to safely access these tools without impacting the broader player base

-------------------------

The aim is to give users the ability to understand and control their own performance rather than relying solely on creators. This would empower power users while keeping the client stable and enjoyable for everyone else.
title: Power-User Optimization & Performance Tools for the Client
